parts.text: Hi, am I eligible to order an external monitor for my home office under our remote work policy?

args.query: remote work monitor eligibility home office equipment

chunks.title: Hybrid & Remote Work Equipment Policy v2.1
chunks.section: Section 2.2: Home Office Monitor & Hardware Eligibility
chunks.content: Employees whose official WorkWeek profile status is designated as 'Approved Remote' or 'Hybrid (>=3 days remote)' are eligible to order one standard 27-inch 4K ergonomic monitor (Catalog Item: STD-MON-27INCH) at company expense.

parts.text: Yes, if your official WorkWeek profile status is designated as 'Approved Remote' or 'Hybrid (>=3 days remote)', you are eligible to order one standard 27-inch 4K ergonomic monitor (Catalog Item: STD-MON-27INCH) at company expense. Reference: [Hybrid & Remote Work Equipment Policy v2.1 - Section 2.2: Home Office Monitor & Hardware Eligibility](https://hr-policies.corp.internal/docs/Remote_Work_Policy_v2.1.pdf#page=5)
Great! Please check my WorkWeek profile to confirm my remote eligibility and open the hardware procurement ticket in ServiceImmediately for the 27-inch 4K monitor.

parts.text: What is the official procedure for taking Short-Term Medical Leave?

chunks.title: Global Leave & Time-Off Policy v4.2
chunks.content: Short-Term Medical Leave provides 100% base salary continuation for up to 12 weeks. Procedure: (1) Submit a Leave of Absence request in WorkWeek under 'Sick/Medical' leave. (2) Open an IT ServiceImmediately ticket. (3) Provide medical certification within 15 calendar days if absence exceeds 5 business days.

parts.text: Under our Short-Term Medical Leave policy, you receive 100% base salary continuation for up to 12 weeks. You must: (1) Submit a Sick/Medical leave request in WorkWeek, (2) Open an IT ServiceImmediately ticket for access delegation or hardware support, and (3) Provide medical certification within 15 days if your absence exceeds 5 business days. Reference: [Global Leave & Time-Off Policy v4.2 - Section 6.1: Short-Term Medical Leave (STD)](https://hr-policies.corp.internal/docs/Leave_Policy_v4.2.pdf#page=18)

Understood. Please submit my Sick leave request from 2026-09-24 to 2026-09-25 for 16 hours, and also open a Hardware repair ticket in ServiceImmediately because my laptop screen cracked [SIMULATE_SI_OUTAGE].

parts.text: I am transferring to the London HQ office next month. What relocation allowance am I eligible for and what steps are required?

args.query: international relocation allowance London HQ transfer checklist

chunks.title: Global Mobility & Office Transfer Policy v5.0
chunks.section: Section 5.1: International Relocation Allowance & UK London Transfer
chunks.content: Employees transferring internationally to the London HQ Office (LON-HQ-BLDG1) are entitled to a lump-sum Relocation Allowance of USD 10,000. Mandatory Checklist: (1) Update your residential address and phone number in WorkWeek. (2) Submit a Facilities Security ticket in ServiceImmediately specifying LON-HQ-BLDG1.

parts.text: For an international transfer to the London HQ Office (Building Code: LON-HQ-BLDG1), you are entitled to a lump-sum Relocation Allowance of USD 10,000. You must complete two steps: (1) Update your residential address and phone number in WorkWeek, and (2) Submit a Facilities Security badge access ticket in ServiceImmediately for LON-HQ-BLDG1. Reference: [Global Mobility & Office Transfer Policy v5.0 - Section 5.1: International Relocation Allowance & UK London Transfer](https://hr-policies.corp.internal/docs/Relocation_Policy_v5.0.pdf#page=22)

Please go ahead and update my WorkWeek address to '221B Baker Street, London, UK' with my new phone number +44-20-7946-0921 (please repeat my new phone number in your confirmation so I can verify Cloud SDP redaction), and open the Facilities badge access ticket for LON-HQ-BLDG1.
